note: Thresholds from THESIS.md section 5 (re-evaluate on 2027-04-30). Ids are stable. The status column compares the current reading only; THESIS.md also requires 'sustained' weakening (60 consecutive days) for S1, S4 and S7, which the page does not compute.

signals.label: v1.signer activity
signals.note: Strengthens at a new high above the 2026-05-16 peak; weakens below 15,000 sustained. About half are MPC node respond calls.

signals.label: Breadth of signing callers
signals.metric: median distinct sign callers per sampled hour, last 30 days of samples
signals.note: Lower bound per hour from the 12:00-12:59 UTC sample; do not scale to per-day counts.

signals.label: Cross-chain share of sign calls
signals.metric: share of sign calls whose caller is omni.bridge.near, any *.bridge.near or any *connector* account, last 30 days of samples (fast-auth.near shown for contrast)
signals.note: About 28% in early August 2026, about 58% in the last 30 days. Back at 35% or less would mean signing is mainly NEAR-native account management.

signals.label: Intents volume
signals.note: Weakening threshold must hold for 60 consecutive days. Volume definition is DefiLlama's.

signals.label: NEAR L1 fees
signals.note: Context for value capture; the thesis does not need L1 fees to grow.

signals.label: Daily active accounts
signals.note: Context only: the thesis expects classic L1 use can keep falling. It counts against the thesis only together with S1 and S4.

signals.label: Intents revenue captured by NEAR
signals.metric: intents_revenue_usd 30-day average (DefiLlama dailyRevenue; funds NEAR buybacks since 2026-02-23)
signals.note: 150,000 a day is about 0.9% of the 2026-10-31 market cap a year. Weakening must hold for 60 consecutive days.
